items.title: Declare Nicotine Vape Illegal As Poison, Stop Collecting Tax: MPs
items.summary: Petaling Jaya and Kuala Langat MPs tell the government to ban nicotine vape as a scheduled poison under the Poisons Act and to stop collecting excise duties on it, saying MOF must also refund businesses over RM354m in excise duties collected since 2023. items.title: Explainer: Three Options For Putrajaya After Withdrawing Nicotine Appeal
items.summary: The government has 3 options to take after dropping its nicotine appeal. Option A: Ban nicotine vape. Option B: Return to the Poisons Board. Option C: Enact a simple Act to classify tobacco and nicotine products as ordinary trade commodities, not poisons. items.title: Nicotine Vape Legality, Control Under MOH’s Jurisdiction: KPDN
items.summary: KPDN says the legality and control of nicotine vape fall under MOH's jurisdiction, not Domestic Trade, because nicotine is "classified as an active chemical substance and poison that directly affects public health, not an ordinary trade commodity".
